info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Product Management Product Trainings-spec
info.description: The Product Training Management API provides a comprehensive overview of available product training resources within the banking product management sector. This endpoint allows users to access a detailed list of training sessions, courses, and materials designed to enhance product knowledge and skills. Typical consumers include training coordinators, product managers, and customer service teams who require up-to-date information on training opportunities. By utilizing this API, organizations can ensure their teams are well-equipped with necessary training to improve service delivery and product expertise.

get.description: Fetch the details related to product training, including available resources, schedules, and other relevant information that can assist users in better understanding the product.
